name: HubSpot Deal Split Revenue Attribution Calculator

parameters.content:
## HubSpot Deal Split Revenue Attribution Calculator
Closed-Won → split slots / owner default / partner carve-out → exact credit + commission → HubSpot properties, Google Sheets rows, analytics ingest.

**Safe by default:** `SANDBOX_MODE=true` sends every calculation to *Dry-Run Telemetry*.
**Error branch:** calculation errors and failed syncs are redacted and sent to `ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL`.

Code nodes are generated from `calculator.js` by `npm run build`; do not edit them in n8n.

nodes.name: HubSpot Deal Stage Changed
nodes.notes: HubSpot developer-app webhook subscription: deal.propertyChange on dealstage. HubSpot signs these requests; the trigger node validates them.

nodes.name: Closed-Won Workflow Webhook
nodes.notes: Alternative entry for a HubSpot workflow "Send a webhook" action. Header x-split-secret must equal WEBHOOK_SECRET.

nodes.name: Normalize Closed-Won Events
nodes.notes: Validates config, filters Closed-Won stage changes, verifies the webhook secret, de-duplicates deals.

nodes.name: HubSpot Get Deal
nodes.notes: Amount, currency, owner, stage and every split slot property.

nodes.name: HubSpot Get Partner Associations
nodes.notes: v4 associations with labels; companies labelled PARTNER_ASSOCIATION_LABEL receive a partner carve-out.

nodes.name: Calculate Splits
nodes.notes: Validation, exact largest-remainder allocation, per-role commission, idempotency check.

nodes.name: Dry-Run Telemetry
nodes.notes: Sandbox branch: logs calculations and errors only.

nodes.name: Route Results
nodes.notes: skipped items (already calculated, stage changed back) match no rule.

nodes.name: Build Sheet Rows
nodes.notes: One row per participant; returns nothing when ENABLE_GOOGLE_SHEETS=false.

nodes.name: Build Analytics Records
nodes.notes: One record per deal; returns nothing when ENABLE_ANALYTICS_INGEST=false.

nodes.name: Analytics Ingest
nodes.notes: POST to your analytics service / database API. Idempotency-Key = calculation ID.

nodes.name: HubSpot Flag Calculation Error
nodes.notes: split_calculation_status=ERROR and split_error_code for a HubSpot view or workflow.

nodes.name: Build Calculation Alert
nodes.notes: Uses the sanitized alert built by calculator.js.

nodes.name: Sanitize Sync Error
nodes.notes: Error output of every sync node: redacts tokens, headers and PII, then alerts.

nodes.name: Send Redacted Alert
nodes.notes: ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL (Slack Incoming Webhook or any JSON endpoint; see ALERT_FORMAT).
